defect.problem: The citation and identity are verified, but the live-law currency angle is not verified from the disclosed record because treatment/progeny are only frontier-stub data.
defect.proposed_fix: Treat this as citation/existence verified only, or complete treatment/progeny verification before using it as live-law authority.

reasons: Lake identity confirms United States v. Arthur Maez, U.S. Court of Appeals, 10th Cir., decided 1989-04-19, docket 88-1128.
Lake citations confirm official cite 872 F.2d 1444 and vendor cites 1989 U.S. App. LEXIS 5092 and 1989 WL 36532.
Lake treatment has no verified good-law basis and progeny rows_cached is 0, so current live-law status is not established from disclosed evidence.
residual_risks: A later overruling, abrogation, or limitation would not appear in this disclosed lake record.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Separate citation-existence verification from live-law verification in the rendered label.

reasons: Lens B does not test support placement or quote fidelity.
No disclosed treatment edge affirmatively overrules, abrogates, or limits Maez for the constructive-entry cross-reference.
The page separately discloses Treatment: Unverified.
residual_risks: Live-law status remains unverified because lake treatment is a frontier stub.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: When this home role is rendered outside the case page, carry the Treatment: Unverified badge with it.

reasons: Lens B does not evaluate whether the holding summary is fully supported by the opinion text.
The disclosed lake record contains no negative treatment edge contradicting the historical holding.
The case page does not present this holding with verified positive treatment; it displays Treatment: Unverified.
residual_risks: The holding's present doctrinal force cannot be confirmed from the unverified treatment fields.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Avoid implying current good-law status for the holding unless treatment is promoted beyond unverified.

defect.evidence_quote: "scope_note": "Frontier stub: treatment/progeny intentionally not derived until S6 promotion."
defect.problem: The 'Key' home role can read as a current-law importance signal, but the disclosed record does not verify Maez's current good-law status.
defect.proposed_fix: Either append a treatment qualifier to the Key role or defer the Key label until treatment/progeny are verified.

reasons: Lake identity supports that Maez is a 10th Circuit case involving the cited constructive-entry topic, but Lens B cannot confirm current doctrinal vitality.
Treatment is expressly unverified and there are no cached progeny rows.
residual_risks: A verified citator pass could still support the Key role; the disclosed evidence just does not prove it now.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Render as 'Key — constructive-entry; treatment unverified' unless promoted.

defect.problem: The jurisdictional weight label is supported by the 10th Circuit identity, but unqualified 'Binding in-circuit' risks implying verified current binding force despite unverified treatment.
defect.proposed_fix: Clarify that the label is jurisdictional weight only, e.g. '10th Cir. in-circuit authority; treatment unverified.'

reasons: Lake identity lists court_level coa and circuit ca10, supporting in-circuit precedential weight as a court-hierarchy label.
Lake treatment is unverified, with no as_of_treatment date and no verified progeny treatment.
residual_risks: If the UI already treats authority_weight as purely jurisdictional, this is only a display-clarity risk.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Pair the weight label with an explicit treatment qualifier everywhere it appears.

reasons: The content treatment fields match the lake: field_i_validity unverified, composite_basis unverified, as_of_content null, as_of_treatment null, varies_by_point false.
The disclosed lake scope note says treatment/progeny were intentionally not derived until S6 promotion.
No disclosed treatment edge asserts a contrary positive or negative treatment status.
residual_risks: Unverified is not a good-law determination; it leaves current validity unresolved.
